verdict.rationale: Algolia ships an official MCP server (documented in the algolia/skills pack as 'algolia-mcp: Search, analytics, and recommendations via the Algolia MCP server') and a runtime probe confirms the hosted server at mcp.algolia.com is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. Additional skills/CLI expose index configuration, rules, synonyms, and analytics operations as agent tools, matching the query/analytics/index-ops scope of the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party reports of actually using the MCP server (only vendor docs and an automated probe corroborate it), and no detail on the full breadth of tool-calling operations exposed beyond the skill descriptions.
